task.title: Reopen selected tool entrypoints for activation
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/620 by reacquiring bounded owned tool artifacts through descriptor-anchored revalidation without executing them.
acceptance_criteria: Reopen the original root, selected package, manifest, and entrypoint without following symlinks.
Reject changed identity, metadata, unsafe targets, wrong kinds, and entrypoints larger than 16 MiB.
Return owned artifacts in exact-ID order with all-or-nothing typed failures.
Perform no compilation, registry mutation, authorization, persistence, or guest execution.

attempts.summary: Established RED coverage for secure tool artifact preparation.
attempts.diagnostic: The extension crate had no preparation API, owned artifact type, size limit, or preparation error contract.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests requiring descriptor-anchored reacquisition, deterministic ordering, the byte boundary, and fail-closed filesystem behavior.

attempts.diagnostic: Discovery metadata is not an activation lease, so preparation must reopen and revalidate the selected package before reading bounded bytes.
attempts.patch: Added prepare_tool_artifacts, owned prepared artifacts, retained filesystem identities, bounded reads, and typed source-preserving errors.

attempts.summary: Reviewed the target identity boundary explicitly.
attempts.diagnostic: Discovery deliberately does not read or lease entrypoint content; preparation securely accepts the current regular file only after package and manifest identity revalidation.
attempts.patch: Documented that content identity or signatures remain a separate contract while package replacement, metadata change, escapes, symlinks, and oversized files fail closed.

outcome.summary: Vela now reacquires selected tool entrypoints as bounded owned artifacts through an anchored, revalidated, non-executing filesystem boundary.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-extensions --test manifest preparation_ --locked
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30204562524 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/622

lessons: Discovery-time validation must not be treated as authority to open an entrypoint later.
Descriptor-anchored traversal keeps selected package identity separate from mutable path names.
Bounded reads should probe one additional byte to distinguish the exact accepted boundary.
Content signatures and discovery-time content leases should not be invented inside a filesystem reacquisition slice.
